name: Fruita Mews (The Fruita Mews)
headline: The Fruita Mews won $1,330,877 a year in 2022 federal 9% housing tax credits from CHFA for 50 new townhome rentals at 1138 18 1/2 Road in Fruita, 44 of them income-restricted at 30% to 60% AMI.
why_it_matters: CHFA describes it as the first housing tax credit development without rental subsidy built in Fruita.

status.label: Credits awarded May 2022; CHFA's award records do not show construction or opening
status.detail: This summary uses only CHFA's published 2022 Round One award and applicant records: the applicant report, the award report and the award descriptions. Those records end at the award.

next_step: CHFA's 2022 award records end at the award; construction start, opening date and final credit are not in them.

key_numbers.meaning: 4 at 30% AMI, 4 at 40%, 12 at 50%, 24 at 60%, and 6 market-rate homes.
About $30,247 per income-restricted home per year (inferred: $1,330,877 divided by 44).
Townhome design with covered front porches, per CHFA's award description.

facts.value: Eureka!, Family Health West and a master gardener, per CHFA's award description

money.note: The applicant report lists $1,330,328 requested. No state credit is shown on the 2022 Round One award report.

parties.role: Owner (as CHFA's award report prints it)
parties.name: Indibuild llc

parties.role: Developer (as CHFA's award description prints it)
parties.name: Indibuild LLC

background.text: A second Fruita application in the same round, Residences at Fruita (614 Raptor Rd., 50 homes), is on CHFA's applicant report but not on the award report.
